correction.text: The same outline, held from the foundation on 23 May 1949 (year 1949) to 31 December 1956: the Saarland is outside it ("Saarland joined West Germany as a state in 1957 after it had been separated as the Saar Protectorate"), and West Berlin is outside it ("formally under the sovereignty of the Western Allies and separate from West Germany").

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's first FRG shape is 1950-1957 at 244,219 km2; the state was founded in 1949 (infobox "Formation: 23 May 1949"), so the shape starts a year late and ends a year late (the Saar acceded on 1 January 1957). Infobox area 248,717 km2 (no year), ratio 0.98 against this shape, 1.01 against the 1958 shape. The gazetteer finds no Saarland cell and no Berlin cell in the shape. The shape's Netherlands tag is grid spill at the border, not Dutch land.

correction.text: The same outline, held from 1 January 1957 (the Saarland acceded: "Saarland did on 1 January 1957") to the end of the state in 1990; West Berlin remains outside it.

keyframe_review.note: 247,305 km2 for 1958-1989: 3,086 km2 more than the 1950 shape, the Saarland (the gazetteer finds 11 cells of Saarland, about 2,782 km2 at grid resolution, in this shape and none in the earlier one). Cliopatria switches in 1958 but the pages date the accession to 1 January 1957 (Saar Treaty of 27 October 1956), so the shape should start in 1957. Infobox 248,717 km2, ratio 0.99.

1990, 247,305 km2, the unchanged West German outline until the accession of 3 October 1990 ("Germany was officially reunited at 00:00 CEST on 3 October 1990"); the Federated Republic of Germany row draws the enlarged state from 1991.

region.text: the American, British and French zones merged as "Trizonia", without the Saar and West Berlin

ledger.note: 1949: the Federal Republic of Germany is founded in the three Western zones, with Bonn as provisional seat. "the Federal Republic of Germany was founded on 23 May 1949 under the terms of the Bonn-Paris conventions" (the page; the conventions themselves are dated 5 May 1955); "Between 1946 and 1949, three of the occupation zones began to merge" into "Bizonia" and "Trizonia". The page names zones, not Lander; the region is the Cliopatria shape.

1957: the Saarland becomes a state of West Germany. "On 27 October 1956 the Saar Treaty established that Saarland should be allowed to become a state of West Germany"; "Saarland did on 1 January 1957" (join); the 1955 referendum of 23 October 1955 had rejected the European statute "by 67.7% to 32.3%". The French franc stayed legal tender in the Saar until 6 July 1959.

region.text: the five East German states and East Berlin

ledger.note: 1990: the Federal Republic absorbs the German Democratic Republic on 3 October. "Germany was officially reunited at 00:00 CEST on 3 October 1990"; the Federal Republic "continued to exist under the same legal personality that was founded in May 1949". Cliopatria and the Federated-Republic dossier treat the enlarged state as a new row.

region.text: the whole West German state, continuing in the enlarged republic

ledger.note: 1990: West Germany ends at reunification on 3 October (infobox "Reunification: 3 October 1990"; "They formally joined the federal republic on 3 October 1990, raising the total number of states from ten to 16"); the state itself continues as the enlarged Federal Republic.

certainty.note: The outline follows zone and state lines fixed in 1945-49 and the inner German border (1,381 km, Inner German border page opened for the GDR dossier); the Saarland boundary became German on 1 January 1957. West Berlin was never part of the state.

notes: Three pages (budget 1-2 plus the reunification page, which was already open for the GDR dossier). Cliopatria's two shape switches both need a one-year correction: the FRG began in 1949 (not 1950) and the Saar joined in 1957 (not 1958). West Berlin: the page says it was "formally under the sovereignty of the Western Allies and separate from West Germany", "politically aligned itself with West Germany", and its members "could not vote" in the Bundestag; no cell of Berlin is in the FRG shape, so it is not drawn as FRG land. The west-berlin dossier (another group, exists in polities/) carries West Berlin and the Allied sectors; the Allied-occupied-germany dossier uses the same slug as a counterpart. Not recorded as events because the pages do not make them territorial: the end of the Allied regime by the Bonn-Paris conventions of 5 May 1955 ("the full authority of a sovereign state"; the page is silent on the Occupation Statute) and full sovereignty on 15 March 1991 (infobox). Border adjustments with the Netherlands or Belgium after 1949: the page is silent, so none is drawn. The FRG legally continues; this dossier ends in 1990-10 only to follow Cliopatria's separate Federated Republic of Germany row. No wars (a Cold War state with no fighting on its borders in the pages opened).
